content: Pfizer Inc. distributes 5 g of sulbactam in the form of its sodium salt. ADD-Vantage® vials containing 3 g of UNASYN (composed of 2 g of ampicillin as the sodium salt and 1 g of sulbactam as the sodium salt) are also distributed by Pfizer Inc. The 5 g UNASYN ADD-Vantage® vials are specifically intended for use with Abbott Laboratories' 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP, available in 50 mL, 100 mL, or 250 mL sizes. Additionally, 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP, in 100 mL or 250 mL sizes is compatible for use.
